name: Tiefenbachgletscher SB Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**Experience the breathtaking views of the Tiefenbachgletscher from the cozy **Tiefenbachgletscher SB Restaurant** in Tirol!**

Nestled at **2,700 meters** above sea level, this alpine gem offers a unique dining experience with panoramic vistas of the **Ötztal Alps**. Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or a warm bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl** while soaking in the crisp mountain air.

After your meal, explore the stunning **Tiefenbachgletscher** on foot or take a thrilling ride on the **Gletscherbahn** (glacier cable car). Whether you're craving adventure or simply want to unwind with a view, this is the perfect stop in the heart of the **Ötztal**.

**Location:** Near **Sölden**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and **Imst**.

**Open:** Seasonal (typically May–October) – check current hours before your visit.

**Reservations recommended!** 🏔️✨
